drive_files_trash_consistency.name: drive_files_trash_consistency
drive_files_trash_consistency.value: ("drive_files"."is_trashed" and "drive_files"."trashed_at" is not null) or (not "drive_files"."is_trashed" and not "drive_files"."trashed_by_parent")

drive_folders_root_shape.name: drive_folders_root_shape
drive_folders_root_shape.value: ("drive_folders"."is_root" and "drive_folders"."parent_id" is null) or (not "drive_folders"."is_root" and "drive_folders"."parent_id" is not null)

drive_folders_trash_consistency.name: drive_folders_trash_consistency
drive_folders_trash_consistency.value: ("drive_folders"."is_trashed" and "drive_folders"."trashed_at" is not null) or (not "drive_folders"."is_trashed" and not "drive_folders"."trashed_by_parent")

file_shares_file_email_unique.name: file_shares_file_email_unique
file_shares_file_email_unique.where: "file_shares"."file_id" is not null and "file_shares"."accepted_at" is null

file_shares_folder_email_unique.name: file_shares_folder_email_unique
file_shares_folder_email_unique.where: "file_shares"."folder_id" is not null and "file_shares"."accepted_at" is null

file_shares_target_matches_type.name: file_shares_target_matches_type
file_shares_target_matches_type.value: ("file_shares"."resource_type" = 'FILE' and "file_shares"."file_id" is not null and "file_shares"."folder_id" is null) or ("file_shares"."resource_type" = 'FOLDER' and "file_shares"."folder_id" is not null and "file_shares"."file_id" is null)

share_links_active_file_unique.name: share_links_active_file_unique
share_links_active_file_unique.where: "share_links"."file_id" is not null and "share_links"."revoked_at" is null

share_links_active_folder_unique.name: share_links_active_folder_unique
share_links_active_folder_unique.where: "share_links"."folder_id" is not null and "share_links"."revoked_at" is null

share_links_target_matches_type.name: share_links_target_matches_type
share_links_target_matches_type.value: ("share_links"."resource_type" = 'FILE' and "share_links"."file_id" is not null and "share_links"."folder_id" is null) or ("share_links"."resource_type" = 'FOLDER' and "share_links"."folder_id" is not null and "share_links"."file_id" is null)

form_logic_rules_target.name: form_logic_rules_target
form_logic_rules_target.value: ("form_logic_rules"."action"::text <> 'GO_TO_SECTION' or "form_logic_rules"."target_section_id" is not null) and ("form_logic_rules"."action"::text <> 'JUMP_TO_FIELD' or "form_logic_rules"."target_field_id" is not null) and ("form_logic_rules"."action"::text not in ('SET_VARIABLE','CALCULATE') or "form_logic_rules"."target_variable_id" is not null)
